window: 4 AM Sat 31 Oct to 4 AM Sun 1 Nov IST
headline: Aadarsha Kutumbam led yesterday with 208K tickets booked, while Jailer 2 (Hindi) was the biggest mover at up 59%.
bullets: Aadarsha Kutumbam ranked first with 208K tickets booked, down 4% from the day before.
Jailer 2 was second with 159K, up 33% on the day before but down 60% against a week ago.
Jailer 2 (Hindi) was the biggest mover, up 59% to 28.7K, and Premada Oorali and Drishyam also rose over 40%.
Namit Malhotra's Ramayana led interest with 531K+ interested and bookings open, and it gained 16K in 24 hours.
No films fell in the rising-or-falling list, and the newest reading is from 8:05 AM today, so the data is current.
